INSERT INTO purchases (supplier, invoice_number, date, description, subtotal, btw_amount, total, btw_rate, grootboek_code, status)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.leverancier }}',
  '{{ $json.factuurnummer }}',
  '{{ $json.datum }}',
  '{{ $json.omschrijving }}',
  {{ $json.bedrag }},
  {{ $json.btw_bedrag }},
  {{ $json.totaal }},
  '{{ $json.btw_pct }}',
  '{{ $json.grootboek }}',
  'geboekt'
)

INSERT INTO ledger_entries (date, account_id, description, debit, credit, reference, journal)
SELECT
  '{{ $json.datum }}',
  id,
  'Inkoop {{ $json.leverancier }} - {{ $json.omschrijving }}',
  {{ $json.bedrag }},
  0,
  '{{ $json.factuurnummer }}',
  'inkoop'
FROM accounts WHERE code = SUBSTR('{{ $json.grootboek }}', 1, 4) LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO ledger_entries (date, account_id, description, debit, credit, reference, journal)
SELECT
  '{{ $json.datum }}',
  id,
  'BTW inkoop {{ $json.leverancier }}',
  {{ $json.btw_bedrag }},
  0,
  '{{ $json.factuurnummer }}',
  'inkoop'
FROM accounts WHERE code = '1530' LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO ledger_entries (date, account_id, description, debit, credit, reference, journal)
SELECT
  '{{ $json.datum }}',
  id,
  'Crediteuren {{ $json.leverancier }}',
  0,
  {{ $json.totaal }},
  '{{ $json.factuurnummer }}',
  'inkoop'
